items.title: Widerspruch gegen Ablehnung des erhöhten Zuschusses
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit dieser Entscheidung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The one-month Widerspruch period runs from the day the decision is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe), which for a statutory health insurer (social-law body) is the 4th day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), not moved even if that day falls on a weekend/holiday. However, this letter carries no printed date, no 'Datum' field and no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' notice anywhere on the page, so the posting day — and therefore the delivery day that starts the one-month period — cannot be determined. Without a known start, the exact due date cannot be computed.

warnings: The letter has no date anywhere on it (no 'Datum' field and no 'zur Post gegeben am' notice), so the start of the one-month Widerspruch period cannot be determined; please check the envelope postmark or any date stamp on your own copy to establish the real deadline.

The letter uses obviously placeholder/example names throughout (Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse, Musterhafen, Mustermünster, Landesmusterbank, 'Gesetzliche Krankenversicherung (Musterausgabe)'), which strongly suggests this is a sample/template document rather than a genuine decision from a real insurer — verify authenticity before relying on it, and do not use the printed IBAN for anything.
